title: Acceptance bounded by optimum acceptance
statement: Let $n$, the proof length, and the query count be natural numbers, and let $V$ be a PCPP system with Boolean inputs of length $n$ and proofs of the stated length. For every input word and every proof word, the verifier's acceptance probability is at most its maximum acceptance probability over all such words.
hypotheses_covered: Natural-number input length, proof length, and query count
A Boolean PCPP system with those parameters
A proof word of the specified length
